name: displacement acquisition frequency
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 位移测量系统单位时间采集数据的频率。
usage_note: 本试验采用50 Hz，属于采集参数而非结构固有频率。

complete_examples.text: The vertical displacement of the loading steel rod is recorded in real-time using an LVDT (Linear variable displacement transducer) system of the SDT-50 platform, representing the mid-span deflection of the specimens, with a displacement acquisition frequency of 50 Hz.
